title: Malaysian Yellow Curry with Haddock
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry made with fresh haddock, yellowish malaysian curry paste, and a blend of spices. Serve with steamed rice or roti for a delicious and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: yellowish malaysian curry paste
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.notes: balances the heat from the curry paste

ingredients.name: lime wedges
ingredients.notes: for serving, adds a touch of acidity

instructions: 1. Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
3. Add the coconut milk and stir to combine. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
4. Add the fish sauce and sugar, stirring to combine.
5. Add the haddock fillets to the curry sauce and cook for 3-4 minutes or until cooked through.
6. Season the curry with salt to taste.
7. Serve the haddock and curry sauce over steamed rice or with roti.
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves, if desired.
9. Serve with lime wedges on the side, for added flavor.
